summary: Unchanged: `ensureCatalog()` recomputes a full-table SHA-256 digest over ~22,347 rows on every launch, even when unchanged.
claim: Avoidable cold-start I/O/CPU cost on the target modest-hardware device on every launch.

evidence.source: `DataStore.ensureCatalog()` (identical to prior submission) unconditionally evaluates `catalogDigest(dao.allForIntegrity()) == expectedContentDigest` as part of the reinstall-skip check on every `init{}`.

suggested_remediation: As previously stated: incremental checksum, periodic/on-demand verification, or equivalent.
suggested_validation: Measure and bound on-device cold-start latency contribution.
